extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: harbour tugboat, approx. 15.3 x 6.4 x 11.5 m (L x W x H incl. mast)
extras.notes: bow faces -Y; sits on its keel at z = 0, add your own water (waterline at 2.3 m: blue boot stripe above the antifouling); tyre fenders on bow and sides; separate moving parts with origin on their axis: tugboat_propeller (inside the nozzle, spins around the shaft), tugboat_rudder (turns around Z), tugboat_winch_drum (rolls around X); opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text, no name, no flag

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
